parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search across name, phone, MRN

roles.description: Recipient roles. Omit / empty = all staff (no PATIENT).

mfaCode.description: 6-digit TOTP code or hex backup code

email.description: Must match the email on file

scope.description: Empty = full proxy. Otherwise list of Action strings to permit.

code.description: Current TOTP code (proves possession before disabling)

withdrawalReason.description: Required when withdrawing a previously granted consent

editedContent.description: Final edited content if decision is EDIT_ACCEPT

isPhi.description: Mark as PHI. Defaults true for clinical categories.

consultationId.description: Optional consultation to anchor the Rx

knownAllergies.description: Patient allergy substances at issue time

currentMedications.description: Patient active medications at issue time

override.description: Override the safety check. Doctor takes responsibility — recorded in audit.

consultationId.description: Optional consultation to attach this chart to

delta.description: Signed delta — negative to write off

batchId.description: Specific batch to adjust; defaults to FEFO order

payload.description: Opaque signaling payload (SDP, ICE candidate, chat text)

acceptedPaymentMethods.description: PaymentMethod values: CASH, GCASH, MAYA, BANK_TRANSFER, CARD, HMO, INSURANCE, OTHER

appointmentWebhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive POST events on appointment lifecycle (create / check-in / cancel). Use Zapier/Make/n8n to bridge into Google or Microsoft Calendar.
